summary: Iteration 3: tested learner Change password (Profile), admin password reset link, welcome email on registration (background), Google-only has_password note, admin /admin/password, and regression (login, dashboard, lesson completion). All new features work in the backend and the UI. 54/54 backend tests pass (AI tests excluded). All UI flows pass. During testing I found and fixed a test-suite bug from iteration 2: TestAdminChange restored the admin password using a token that the first change had already invalidated, so the admin password was left on a random temporary value. I restored the admin password directly in Mongo and fixed the test.

minor.issue: If the lessons collection is empty, first['id'] raises TypeError outside the try block. It is only logged as an unhandled background-task exception and does not affect registration.
Accepts a new password identical to the current one. Optional UX improvement.
Real sends currently fail as expected (insufficient_credits, undeliverable, and also 429 rate-limit seen). Logged as 'Welcome email failed'. Registration is unaffected.

action_items: Optional: guard send_welcome against a missing first lesson (move the lookup inside try)
Optional: reject a new password equal to the current one
critical_code_review_comments: change_password and reset_password both bump token_version correctly. The new token is returned and saved by ChangePasswordForm via setToken, so the current session survives and older tokens get 401 (verified).

admin_reset_link: admin-only (401 no token, 403 learner, 404 unknown, 422 invalid email). Email lookup is case-insensitive. The link is single-use and lasts 1h (verified). It is not rate-limited, which is acceptable for admin use only.
Background tasks for the welcome email keep registration fast (<10s, typically under 1s).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the suite with the default pytest.ini (-n 2 loadscope) or with -n 0. Deselect tests/test_ai15_api.py::TestAI to skip AI. Any test that changes a password must use the token returned by change-password, because token_version invalidates older tokens. To test Google-only users, insert a user with password_hash '' and sign a JWT {sub, type:'access', tv:0, exp} using JWT_SECRET (HS256).
rca of the issue: Admin password left changed: TestAdminChange (iteration 2) called change-password a second time to restore, using the original admin_tok. The first change bumped token_version, so the restore got 401 and the admin was stuck on TempAdmin_xxxx. Mitigation: restored the bcrypt hash in Mongo and changed the test to restore with r.json()['token'].
